the transcription factor ΔFosB is induced in the medial pre-optic area by mating and cocaine history, and that ΔFosb overexpression in this area impairs copulation and promotes female-directed aggression.

how experience with drugs of abuse or natural rewards can alter the brain's reward system and how this can lead to addiction and/or compulsive drug seeking.
